sections.heading: Gaming spaces for businesses that bring in revenue.
sections.headingHtml: Gaming spaces for businesses that bring in revenue.
sections.lede: We build esports rooms for businesses that want to bring customers in and keep them coming back, from LAN centers to hotel lounges to casino floors. Each one is built to earn its keep.

images.alt: Players in team jerseys competing at gaming stations

sections.heading: For every kind of commercial venue.
sections.lede: Every business makes money from the room in a different way. We design around how yours will.

cards.title: LAN Centers
cards.subtitle: Rooms built for heavy, paying use.
cards.body: A LAN center has to handle serious players, long hours, and real revenue targets. We build them to perform at scale, with enterprise networking, managed services, and lab management in place from day one.

cards.title: Hotels & Hospitality
cards.subtitle: An amenity that gives guests a reason to book.
cards.body: An esports lounge gives guests a reason to book, stay longer, and come back. We build guest-ready rooms with enterprise networking and managed services included.

cards.title: Casinos & Entertainment
cards.subtitle: A draw for younger guests.
cards.body: Esports lounges on casino floors and in entertainment venues bring in younger guests that traditional gaming doesn’t reach. We build high-spec rooms with broadcast capability to match the production quality your guests expect.

cards.title: Healthcare
cards.subtitle: Gaming for therapy and patient engagement.
cards.body: Pediatric waiting rooms, occupational therapy programs, and veteran wellness centers use gaming for therapy and engagement. We build right-sized, secure rooms that meet compliance requirements and serve patients where they are.

sections.lede: Stafford MSD is a school district, but the work is the same one we’d do for your venue: cabling, network, hardware, and someone to call after you open.

Tell us about your venue, and we’ll scope it the same way.

cards.title: Not sure where to start?
cards.body: Answer a few questions about your space and program, and we’ll send you a free readiness report.

faqs.q: How quickly can you deploy a commercial esports facility?
faqs.a: It depends on scope, but commercial projects move faster than public ones because there are no procurement delays. Once the scope is approved, we source and install without the back-and-forth that slows public sector projects.

faqs.q: Do you offer leasing or hardware-as-a-service options?
faqs.a: Yes. Spread the cost over 12, 24, or 36 months with predictable payments and built-in hardware refresh cycles. You can bundle them with managed services for one monthly cost.

faqs.q: What ongoing support do you provide after the build?
faqs.a: Managed services cover day-to-day lab operations, session and billing management, monitoring, cybersecurity, and dedicated IT support.

faqs.q: Can we roll out across multiple locations or franchise sites?
faqs.a: Yes. Deployments and the League scale from a single location to regional and nationwide networks.

faqs.q: How does the TANCHES.GG League work for commercial venues?
faqs.a: We design the format and run scheduling, brackets, and results, so you get a recurring draw. Your team runs the space.

faqs.q: What kind of ROI can we expect from an esports facility?
faqs.a: It depends on your venue and model. We design for revenue beyond gameplay, such as shared use, events, and repeat visits, and we scope it around your goals during the assessment.
